Abstract.AbstractText: The above article from European Journal of Neuroscience, published online on 4 February 2014 in Wiley Online Library (http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/ejn.12475/full), has been retracted by agreement between the Editors-in-Chief, Paul Bolam and John Foxe, the authors and John Wiley & Sons Ltd. The retraction has been agreed as the above article has been found to overlap substantially with the article 'Chiou, L.-C., Hu, S. S.-J., and Ho, Y.-C. (2013), Targeting the cannabinoid system for pain relief? Acta Anaesthesiologica Taiwanica, Volume 51, Issue 4: 161 - 170. doi: 10.1016/j.aat.2013.10.004', which was submitted after the European Journal of Neuroscience article but was published first. Reference Hu, S.S.-J., Ho, Y.-C. & Chiou, L.-C. (2014) No more pain upon Gq-protein-coupled receptor activation: role of endocannabinoids.

Article.ArticleTitle: No more pain upon Gq-protein-coupled receptor activation: role of endocannabinoids.
